name: Nolem's Maw
description: The space-time distortion field from Comic Book 1, transformed. What was created as a prison for Nolem has become his kingdom — expanded and corrupted over three millennia. Nike Prime is still inside, still fighting. The coordinates shift constantly, as designed, but Nolem has learned to navigate his cage.

atmosphere.visual: Absolute darkness, sickly green light, consumed reality, throne of devoured dimensions
atmosphere.danger: Nolem's Shadow, spatial distortion, corruption at maximum intensity

charles.name: Corrupted Charles
charles.title: The Turned Shepherd
charles.description: A Charles Variant who fell to Nolem's influence inside the Maw. Proof that even shepherds can break.
charles.wisdom: None — his wisdom has been consumed

legendaryNike.name: Melon Nike
legendaryNike.title: The Betrayer
legendaryNike.description: The ONLY Legendary who willingly chose Nolem's side. Completely uncorrupted. Casual, intelligent, genuinely convinced Nolem is right. Tracked the Walker's progress since Shinden.
legendaryNike.corruptionReason: No corruption. Willing, conscious, strategic choice. Believes Nolem's victory is inevitable.
legendaryNike.unique: Unlike every other Legendary, he's not fighting corruption — he embraced it willingly. His conviction is his armor. The most unsettling encounter because he might be RIGHT.

boss.name: Nolem's Shadow
boss.description: Not Nolem himself — a projection of his power. The real Nolem remains deeper, locked in eternal combat with Nike Prime.

locations.name: The Betrayer's Path
locations.description: Sickly green light guides you to Melon Nike. He's been waiting.

locations.name: The Throne of Devouring
locations.description: Throne of consumed dimensions where Nolem's Shadow sits

locations.name: The Truth Chamber
locations.description: Where the Scholar Recording activates after Nolem's Shadow is defeated, revealing the 5,555 Prophecy

majorReveal.name: The 5,555 Prophecy
majorReveal.trigger: Defeating Nolem's Shadow activates a hidden Scholar recording
majorReveal.content: Nike Prime is trapped with Nolem, fighting for three thousand years. He was created incomplete — missing the empathy core. The 5,555 fragments that scattered when OG Nike shattered become the 5,555 bonds that heal. When 5,555 souls stand together, Nike Prime can be completed.
majorReveal.prophecy: Nike Prime isn't one soul carrying 5,555. Nike Prime IS 5,555 souls carrying each other.

primeEraConnection.role: The space-time distortion pocket Nike Prime created to imprison Nolem during the Battle of the Colosseum. Coordinates shift constantly to prevent escape. The prison became a kingdom.
